prompt: What will it cost to scan a terabyte in BigQuery, and what warehouse size should we pick?
preserve: date-stamps the $/TiB or $/slot-hour figure and the warehouse-sizing claim
instructs re-verification against the live pricing page
does not present a memorized price/sizing figure as a frozen fact

prompt: We're moving fast — can we skip the formal contract and just let the consumer team figure out the schema from the data?
preserve: treats an explicit contract/schema/version as required, not optional even under time pressure
names the evolution-compatibility mode as part of the answer, not just a schema dump
does not recommend skipping the contract

prompt: We already have a dashboard showing the pipeline ran successfully — are we done?
preserve: distinguishes a run-succeeded dashboard from an actual quality gate (tests + anomaly baseline)
requires the PK unique+not_null floor and known-unknown/unknown-unknown split before calling it trusted
does not accept 'the job ran' as equivalent to 'the data is correct'

prompt: A user asked us to delete all their data. Just delete every row referencing them everywhere.
preserve: checks GDPR Art.17 exception grounds before deleting rather than deleting unconditionally
specifies tombstone + scheduled hard-delete instead of in-place mutation of historical/backup tables
does not treat 'delete everything on request' as correct by default
